title: Kanssa with one companion
focus: Put a singular genitive before kanssa (“with”): Annan kanssa (“with Anna”).
prerequisiteSkills: Location postpositions with a singular genitive

exercises.prompt: Complete “I am with Anna.” Olen ____ kanssa. Use Anna (singular).
exercises.explanation: Use Annan before kanssa. The companion expression is a singular genitive; the speaker remains one person.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: Put a singular genitive before kanssa (“with”): Annan kanssa (“with Anna”).

parts.formation: Olen is the supplied first-person singular present form of olla; it already includes “I”.
Use Annan before kanssa. The companion expression is a singular genitive; the speaker remains one person.
Put kanssa after the genitive noun or name.
